deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page. It is an administrative register in Gauss's hand titled 'Meine Correspondenz vom Ende Octobers 1798 bis Ende 1814' ('My correspondence from the end of October 1798 to the end of 1814'). It is a numbered, roughly alphabetical list of correspondents, entries 1 to 64 (Ahle(s) to Helwig), in two columns. The list continues on the facing page with entries 65 onward.

Each entry has four parts: a serial number, a name, the number of letters n_k from (or exchanged with) that person, and a running cumulative total S_k = S_{k-1} + n_k. Some names carry a cross (†), probably marking the person as deceased. Two names carry an asterisk (*Enke, *v. Ende), probably later insertions or corrections to the alphabetical order.

The only 'computation' is the running sum. I checked it entry by entry. Ahle 7 gives 7. Then Bartels +3 = 10, Benzenberg +16 = 26, Bessel +48 = 74, Besser 75, Best 76, Blum +12 = 88, Bode +33 = 121, Böhmer +4 = 125, Bohnenberger 126, Bolyai +16 = 142, Bosse 144, Bouvard 148, Brandes 149, Breitkopf +9 = 158, Bruns 160, Bugge 162, then +1 each through 167. Christmann 169, Cnopf 171, Crelle 174, Curatorium +6 = 180, then 181, 182, Delambre 185, then 186 through 191 at +1 each. v. Ettrodt 194, Enke 197, Eschenburg Sen. 198, Eschenburg Jun. 202, Faust 205, Fischer 206, Fleckeisen 210, v. Ende 212, Fleischer +11 = 223, Franz 229, Fraunhofer 231, Fries 233, Fritsch 238, Fuss 247, Gauss 248, Gebhardi 249, Gerling +32 = 281, Germain +8 = 289, then 290, 292, 293, 294, 295. Harding +113 = 408, Harjes 409, Hausmann 410, Hauss/Hauff 412, Heeren 414, Helwig 415.

All 64 partial sums are arithmetically consistent. The next page continues seamlessly with Herschel 1 giving 416.

Historically, the counts reflect the known weight of Gauss's early correspondence:
- Harding: 113 (by 415 cumulative).
- Bessel: 48.
- Bode: 33.
- Gerling: 32.
- Wolfgang (Farkas) Bolyai: 16.
- Sophie Germain: 8, matching the 1804–1808 exchange.
- The next page adds Olbers 161 and Lindenau 120.
errors: No arithmetic errors: every cumulative total equals the previous total plus the letter count.

Possible chronological inconsistency, not an arithmetic error. The title says 'bis Ende 1814', yet the list (with its continuation) includes Crelle, Cauchy and Jacobi, whose known exchanges with Gauss date mainly from the 1820s. Either the list was extended later, or these are other persons of the same name (e.g. a different Jacobi), or the count was compiled retrospectively. Worth checking against the Göttingen Briefdatenbank.

results.what: Register of incoming/outgoing correspondence 1798–1814, with per-correspondent letter counts and running cumulative totals

deep.surprise_reason: Purely administrative bookkeeping with simple running sums. Gauss's correspondence lists are known archival material; no mathematical content.

checkable.asserts: The left column (entries 1–32) cumulates to 188 at Duvivier.
The right column (entries 33–64), starting from 188, cumulates to 415 at Helwig.
Every running total in the left column matches the manuscript.
The total of all letter counts on the page equals the final cumulative figure, 415.

transcription_corrections: Title year should read '1798' ('vom Ende Octobers 1798').
Entry 1 may be 'Ahles' rather than 'Ahle' (final stroke/comma unclear).
Entry 62 'Hauss[?]' is written with the same long-s ligature as 'Gauſs' and 'Fuſs', so read 'Hauſs' (Hauß). 'Hauff' (J. K. F. Hauff) is also possible.
The † marks (Brandes, Bruns, Bugge, Caesar, Harjes) and the * marks (Enke, v. Ende) are correctly placed. The † is written beside the name column, not in the count column.
